text.description_html:
First Impressions DS-SS-5.5 Contemporary Long Stainless Steel Door Stop

Constructed of solid stainless steel this 5-1/2" long contemporary door stop screws onto the baseboard casement, door bottom or wall anchor, to protect not just the wall and door, but your door knob or lever as well.

These extra long door stops are suited for special applications. Typically used to keep a door from hitting a obstacle mounted on a wall. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

Specifications of First Impressions DS-SS-5.5 Long Door Stop

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Length: 5-1/2"
  • Diameter: 1/2"
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • White Rubber Bumper Tip

Note: These extra long door stops are hand crafted in the USA. They can be made to other lengths for your specific application. Please Contact Us with your requirements.

*Sold Individually

** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
